sections.heading: 1. Accepting the terms
sections.body: By creating an account and using the TruckSOS app you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: 2. What TruckSOS is
sections.body: TruckSOS connects carriers with broken-down trucks to available mechanics. The app only facilitates contact: the price, the work itself and the payment are agreed directly between carrier and mechanic. TruckSOS is not a party to their contract and does not guarantee the quality, availability or outcome of the services provided. The app also includes a Market section, where users can post listings for parts, tyres, trucks and trailers. Here too TruckSOS only facilitates contact: negotiation, payment and delivery happen directly between buyer and seller, outside the app. We do not verify the goods offered and we are not liable for transactions between users. Sellers are responsible for complying with applicable law, including tax and consumer-protection obligations if they sell in a professional capacity.

sections.heading: 3. Your account
sections.body: You create your account with real details and use it personally. You are responsible for keeping your credentials safe and for everything done from your account. One account corresponds to one person or company.

sections.heading: 4. Your content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the content you publish (breakdown announcements, Market sale listings, photos, attached files, messages, reviews). You grant us a limited licence to store and display it in the app, strictly to operate the service. Illegal, misleading or offensive content, false announcements and spam are forbidden. Market transactions are concluded directly between users; TruckSOS is not a party to the sale, does not process payments and does not guarantee the listed items.

sections.heading: 5. Conduct and moderation
sections.body: You can report content or users and you can block any user. Moderation is reactive: we review incoming reports and may remove content or suspend, temporarily or permanently, accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is", without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, TruckSOS is not liable for damages arising from the relationship between carrier and mechanic, from temporary unavailability of the service or from user-published content.

sections.heading: 7. Termination
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time, directly from the app (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or by email. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: 8. Your data
sections.body: How we process personal data is described in the Privacy policy, which is part of these terms.

sections.heading: 9. Governing law and contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by Romanian law. For any question you can write to us at trucksos.support@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: TruckSOS is a mobile app that connects carriers with broken-down trucks to available mechanics, and that includes a classified-ads section (Market) between users. The data controller is the developer of TruckSOS; you can contact us any time at trucksos.support@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: Account data: your email address and password (the password is handled encrypted by our authentication provider; we never see it). Profile data: name, role, phone number, company, contact email, address, VAT number, specialisation, activity zone, profile photo and chosen language. Published content: breakdown announcements (description, location, truck details, plate number, photos and — only if you choose to attach it — the GPS position), Market sale listings (title, description, price, category, photos), private messages, public-channel messages, the photos and files you attach in conversations, reviews and reports. Technical data: your device's push notification token, your mechanic-search history (kept in your account so we can show you your recent searches) and, for mechanics, the reference position if set for the radius filter.

sections.heading: 3. Who sees what
sections.body: Your phone number is NOT public: only the user you have an open conversation with can see it. Your name, profile photo, company and contact email are visible to signed-in users. Mechanics' address and VAT number are shown on their public profile as provider information. Private messages are visible only to the conversation participants; public-channel messages are visible to signed-in users — each user sees the messages sent after their account was created, and administrators can view the entire channel for moderation. Open announcements are visible to mechanics. Active Market sale listings are visible to all signed-in users, together with your name and profile photo; buyer and seller contact each other exclusively through the in-app chat, and we neither process payments nor collect payment data. Photos and files attached in a conversation are visible only to that conversation's participants, and those sent in the public channel to all signed-in users. When you share a breakdown announcement, a Market listing or a mechanic's profile inside a conversation, the card you send contains their public details. Your search history is visible only to you.

sections.heading: 4. Where the data is stored
sections.body: Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure, in the European Union (Ireland, AWS region eu-west-1). Sub-processors: Supabase (database, authentication, file storage), Expo (push notification delivery), Google (map display on Android) and Brevo (sending authentication emails — confirmation and password-reset codes; EU-based company).

sections.heading: 5. Moderation and administrative access
sections.body: You can report messages or users and you can block any user. Administrators do NOT have general access to your private conversations: they can only see a limited window of messages around a reported message or, for a report against a user, a limited window of the conversations between the reporter and the reported user. Every such access is recorded in an audit log. Accounts that break the rules may be suspended.

sections.heading: 6. Retention and deleting your account
sections.body: Data is kept while your account is active. You can delete your account directly from the app (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or by email; deletion is immediate and irreversible. Text messages you sent in other people's conversations remain visible anonymised, marked as coming from a deleted user — everything else (profile, breakdown announcements, Market sale listings, photos, attached files, reviews, favourites and search history) is permanently deleted.

sections.heading: 7. Legal bases
sections.body: We process data to perform the contract (providing the service the app offers) and on the basis of legitimate interest (moderation, user safety, abuse prevention).

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right of access, rectification (directly in the app), erasure, restriction, objection and portability. For any request write to us at trucksos.support@gmail.com. You can also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority — in Romania, ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro).

sections.heading: 9. Who the service is for
sections.body: TruckSOS is intended for road transport professionals. The service is not directed at minors.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy; we will notify you in the app about important changes. The date of the last update is shown above.
